themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, often involving complex workflows and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including analysis of their performance and usage.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI applications that directly assist in the design process, from UI generation to prototyping and creative asset development.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific software and platforms that leverage AI to enhance various research methodologies and data analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, impact, and implications of AI chatbots, including their potential for deception and cognitive effects.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications for creating, analyzing, and optimizing surveys, including insights into user responses and survey design.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, hiring practices, and the overall professional landscape, including concerns about job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating testing processes across software development, quality assurance, and various product functionalities.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques used to analyze user sentiment from feedback, reviews, and other qualitative data sources.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Discusses AI capabilities in condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for easier comprehension.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
